title: Cauliflower Fritters with Yoghurt, Garlic and Dill Sauce
subtitle: with sunflower seeds
description: Cauliflower fritters with oats and sunflower seeds, served with a garlicky dill yoghurt sauce. A light, easy dinner for a warm evening.

steps.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil. Add the cauliflower, return to the boil over high heat and cook for 20 minutes, then reduce the heat and cook for 5 minutes more or until soft.
Drain the cauliflower and mash in a food processor to an almost smooth puree. Transfer to a large bowl.
Finely chop the parsley. Add the parsley, sunflower seeds, salt and pepper, then the beaten egg and oats and mix. If the mixture is too wet, add a tablespoon of oats.
Heat 2-3 cm of canola oil in a wide frying pan over high heat.
Form fritters with an ice cream scoop or spoon and add to the hot oil. Fry on both sides until golden, then lift out with a slotted spoon onto paper towel.
Finely chop the dill and crush the garlic. Mix the yoghurt with the dill, garlic, salt and pepper, and serve with the fritters.
